LifeOS v2.0.9 (Build 33):
• Fixed Spending tab colors (no more white-on-white text when toggling Money Lent)
• Removed redundant space and unwanted second page across all interfaces
• Centered M3 Saved & Edited feedback dialogs with official Google Material Symbols
• Official Google Material Symbols: Delete Forever, Edit, and Save icons
• High-performance 120 FPS greeting with 10-minute cooldown & instant in-app update popup
